item.title: How I Escaped Firefox's Sandbox and Ended Up With a $0 Bounty
item.author: quactv
item.description: CVE-2026-124855 / Firefox / High / November 2026 A Blob URL comparison in Firefox let a compromised content renderer cross into a privileged about:newtab context. I chained it to native code execution, reported it to Mozilla, and eventually got a CVE with my name on it. The bug was fixed. The bounty wasn’t quite what I expected. Mozilla’s bug bounty program offers up to $20,000 for a sandbox escape. My report ended up with sec-bounty-.
